name: idle

Create one coherent QUIET IDLE breathing-and-blink loop: 12 genuinely sequential subtly different frames, one blink in frames 5-7, chest breath and soft cape settling, fixed feet/pelvis, no whole body sway. Duplicate this exact sequence WITHOUT HAT in the second half, same body/head scale, complete copper hair. ONE sheet, exactly FOUR columns and SIX rows of EQUAL SQUARE cells, preferably 1536x2304 pixels. First 3 rows=12 with-hat frames; last 3 rows=12 identical no-hat poses. Solid pure #FF00FF background, NO ground/shadow/text/grid labels or outlines. All24 figures fully isolated. Genuine smooth keyframes; no copying a static pose twenty-four times.

No scenes, no detached effects.

name: platforms-a
prompt: Create a production-ready gothic platform asset strip for a 2D desktop game, stylistically coherent with this classic Sumrak reference: hand-painted storybook gothic illustration, confident dark ink contours, purple-blue slate stone, copper and navy color echoes, tiny turquoise living moss and very sparse amber lantern light. Each platform is horizontally long about 5:1, top is one perfectly LEVEL continuous walkable stone line, complete left end and right end; full underside remains in its own row with wide margins. Row1 ruined pointed-gothic arcade island with three arches and suspended fractured stone; row2 collapsed cathedral cornice with carved raven motifs and hanging chains; row3 broken slate buttress ledge with ironwork and narrow amber lamp. Central half of each platform has repeatable stone structure and unobstructed flat walkable top, ends distinctive. NO square atlas cells; one landscape strip per row. Rich material detail but large readable silhouettes and a limited dark blue-violet palette. 1536x1024 landscape sheet, three equal height rows, platforms stay completely inside each row. Transparent arch holes show pure magenta. This is gameplay platform art with exact horizontal contact edge.
